title: The leak scan reads a prose secret assignment followed by a comma, bracket or backtick as a placeholder and passes it
goal: kbpublic.file_hits flags an unquoted prose secret assignment whose value is followed by , ) ] } or a backtick, as it flags one followed by a full stop or a space; the adversarial corpus gains rows for those layouts. Found by the SP-fn7letri review (G1): ASSIGNMENT's value swallows the trailing punctuation and _value then reads it as a code expression (kbcommon.py:260-291).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as p;v='Pass'+'12345x';r=[bool([h for h in p.file_hits('kb/public/x.md',t,{}) if h[0]=='secret']) for t in ['the password: '+v+', then rotate','(password='+v+')','password=`'+v+'`']];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)
